description: Pure library module per Appendix B. Exports pattern detection for MCP server tool definitions: (a) progressive-disclosure pattern (≤4 high-level tools), (b) brute-force enumeration (≥20 tools), (c) hybrid. Takes tool-definitions list, returns {pattern: str, tool_count: int, evidence: dict}. Attribution in docstring: 'Cloudflare enterprise MCP reference architecture, blog.cloudflare.com, 2026-04-14.' No daemons. No network. No DB. Compiled patterns at module load. Must include if __name__ == '__main__' self-smoke exercising detection against ≥3 known-good inputs.
